name: agentic-aac-board-maker
description: Generate evidence-informed, accessible AAC boards and classroom communication resources from teacher intent.

interface.longDescription: Turns teacher intent into draft AAC boards, visual supports, printable resources, Open AAC Studio JSON, and offline HTML tools with communication rights, access method, curriculum/QCIA translation, privacy, and QA built in.
defaultPrompt: Make an eye-gaze AAC board for this lesson.
Create a QCIA community access board.
Review this AAC board against the QA rubric.
